method.matte: frozen extract, clamp, preserve_particles=True; 16px green border in RAM cropped away
method.seam_cost: mean absolute RGB 0..255 where both alpha==255; zero elsewhere; singly supported pixels win
method.seam_dp: plus/minus one pixel per step; feather +/-3px; overlapping corner assigned lower mean path cost
method.noise: seed 7; cubic interpolated uniform lattice; wavelengths 420/210/105; amplitudes 1/.5/.25; full-field minmax [0,1]
method.void_eligibility: strictly above 1..400 pixels, inclusive +/-64 columns, 2D max-filter then preceding-row accumulation
method.alpha_edges: maximal fixed-line runs; either direction; union of 1px and 2px threshold steps; reported separately for each fixed line
method.void_extent: farthest qualifying void pixel below bottommost FACE per FACE-containing column; zero if none; canvas-truncated columns retained
